A '''claymore''' is a heavy sword that can block attacks like a shield. There are two: the [[Steel Claymore|steel claymore]] and the [[Adamant Claymore|adamant claymore]].

== Obtaining ==
Both are smithed with a [[Smithing Upgrade Template|smithing upgrade template]]: an iron sword with steel alloy, or a diamond sword with adamant alloy.

== Usage ==
Using a claymore raises it to block. The steel claymore blocks 70% of melee and 60% of projectile damage; the adamant claymore 80% and 70%. Blocking costs durability equal to a quarter of the blocked damage, and axes disable the steel claymore twice as long as a shield.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/steel_claymore.json}}</ref>
